cases.name: eval-top-months-chart
cases.prompt: I have a CSV of monthly sales data in data/sales_2025.csv. Can you find the top 3 months by revenue and make a bar chart?
cases.expected_output: A bar chart image showing the top 3 months by revenue, with labeled axes and values.

assertion_results.text: The output includes a bar chart image file
The chart title or caption mentions revenue

cases.name: eval-clean-missing-emails
cases.prompt: there's a csv in my downloads called customers.csv, some rows have missing emails — can you clean it up and tell me how many were missing?
cases.expected_output: A cleaned CSV with missing emails handled, plus a count of how many were missing.

assertion_results.text: Missing emails are flagged, not silently dropped
assertion_results.evidence: 3 rows flagged 'MISSING' (Bob Jones, David Lee, Frank Green)

assertion_results.text: Row count is preserved (no customer records lost)
